convert_flax_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a Flax FNet checkpoint to PyTorch using the config file and save the result
build_fnet_model_from_config: build a PyTorch FNetForPreTraining model from a JSON configuration file
restore_flax_checkpoint: restore a Flax checkpoint from disk and extract the target parameters dictionary
map_embeddings_to_pytorch: map Flax embedding layer weights to PyTorch state dict with transposed kernels
save_pytorch_model: save a PyTorch FNetForPreTraining model with loaded state dict to a directory
